title: File:Circular Knitic circular knitting machine DSCF2170.jpg
author: Mary Mark Ockerbloom
credit: Science History Institute, Mary Mark Ockerbloom
description: Circular Knitic, a circular knitting machine, displayed as part of the museum exhibition Second Skin: The Science of Stretch at the Chemical Heritage Foundation, on view from November 4, 2016 to May 13, 2017. The Circular Knitic is an Open Hardware make-your-own Knitting Machine developed by Varvara Guljajeva & Mar Canet using digital fabrication techniques such as 3D printing, laser cutting, makerbeam, and Arduino.
